name: Sanguine Nights
source:
Find your muse or die trying! You are a fledgling Toreador who moved to Atlanta after their hometown was burned by the Inquisition. Get to know a few of the kindred in the city, level up your skills and keep the beast under control over two weeks while someone from your past is hunting you.

[From [url=https://ninanonagon.itch.io/sanguine-nights]Itch.io[/url]]
translation: 找到你的缪斯，否则就拼命到死！你是一名新生的托瑞多族吸血鬼。家乡被宗教裁判所焚毁后，你搬到了亚特兰大。在两周内结识城里的几位血族、提升技能、控制体内的野兽，同时还要躲避一名正在追捕你的旧日仇敌。[引自[url=https://ninanonagon.itch.io/sanguine-nights]Itch.io[/url]]
